description: IFRS 9 Simplified Approach — ECL provision matrix for trade receivables, IFRS 15 contract assets, and IFRS 16 lease receivables. Ages each receivable into buckets (current / 1-30 / 31-60 / 61-90 / 91-180 / 180+ days past due). Applies entity-supplied historical loss rates per bucket. Returns per-invoice ECL, portfolio summary, movement schedule (opening→closing provision, P&L charge), and IFRS 7.35H disclosure stub. NOT for the general 3-stage approach (loans, bonds) — use ifr_calculate with standard "ifrs9" for those. Token required; costs 10 credits.

bucketRates.description: Entity-supplied historical loss rates per aging bucket

1_30.description: Loss rate for 1-30 days past due

31_60.description: Loss rate for 31-60 days past due

61_90.description: Loss rate for 61-90 days past due

91_180.description: Loss rate for 91-180 days past due

current.description: Loss rate for not-yet-due receivables, e.g. 0.005

over180.description: Loss rate for 180+ days past due, e.g. 0.50

previousECL.description: Opening ECL provision balance for movement schedule

receivables.description: Portfolio of trade receivables to age and provision

dueDate.description: ISO date — if absent, classified as current

name: ifr_ecl_provision_matrix
